project.currentFocus: Run the documented controlled-motion, warehouse-world and restart-recovery simulation scenarios
project.nextAction: Run S4-B controlled motion in the depot world and preserve odometry, scan and TF evidence
currentBlockers: Controlled-motion, warehouse-world and restart-recovery scenarios are defined but have not yet been run with preserved evidence.

result.summary: Gazebo Sim 8 loaded the depot world and spawned the TurtleBot4 model. Simulation time, TF, LiDAR, odometry, RGB image, depth image and camera calibration streams were verified. A repeatable four-scenario validation procedure and simulation-to-real parity matrix were added; motion, warehouse and restart scenarios still require execution evidence.

history.title: Stage 4 validation scenarios and simulation-to-real parity documented
history.detail: The depot simulation baseline and sensor interfaces are verified. Repeatable motion, warehouse and restart scenarios are now defined, and simulation-to-real differences are documented. Those three scenarios remain open until execution evidence is returned.
